notes.title: The Academy Newsletter: November Edition
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36022497/0ba19873c2a8447b6a7bc1a7c7d42398c5f7c5ba.png[/img]

Hello everyone!!

Hope you all enjoyed a fun Halloween weekend and found some good Halloween parties!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36022497/a82e00182d9de0e016558124993bd7362001dd42.gif[/img]

We've just uploaded our biggest update! The new build includes an updated HUD which is ~20% larger, bug fixing, updated Chinese localisation and some more changes. You can [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1158220/announcements/detail/3065256683891646429]read the full list here[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36022497/be4fd08c6fa5f3bd87296aceede7a74b34861ce3.gif[/img]

Last month we picked the fanart contest winners!

The winner of the Broccoli Girl plushie is [url=https://www.instagram.com/ilka.hesche/]@ilka.hesche[/url] with this super cute Broccoli Girl with a giant head. Love all the small details!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36022497/b0ae0cb0b3115e21b8a129952d76bd889b6ba5ea.jpg[/img]

[url=https://www.instagram.com/karadraws.jpg/]@karadraws.jpg[/url] is one of the winners of the set of stickers and pin with this fantastic piece of Mepsi-loving Ms Markova!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36022497/d8ed629201eeda710394d4748f7a335c13f12c10.png[/img]

We'll announce the rest of the winners in the upcoming newsletters and on social media!
So good to see that the winning packages have started to arrive!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36022497/0f45fd71c7678810e38150e534adaf8bb929fb50.jpg[/img]

Looking into the future, the Happy Broccoli Games team is already working on new stuff, of which we can't reveal much yet! However, we can already mention that we will announce a **singer casting** very soon! Keep an eye on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/6364PA6Jkv]Discord [/url]and [url=https://twitter.com/happybroccgames]Twitter[/url] if you don't want to miss the announcement!

You too could have your own fanclub!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36022497/974bbc3e4d3a12469a0993f0df15a46b5f0239c1.gif[/img]

Finally, we're looking at getting a Metacritic User score. If you enjoyed the game, we would really appreciate if you could leave a review under [url=https://www.metacritic.com/game/pc/kraken-academy!!/user-reviews]User Reviews[/url]. <3

Oh and many thanks to our Publisher Fellow Traveller for gifting us a framed copy of the key art <3 (Key art by [url=https://www.artstation.com/adrianwilkins]Adrian Wilkins[/url]).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36022497/0871aacb8072158dee0e77d376f3b7cdb61a3549.jpg[/img]

See you next month!

Join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/6364PA6Jkv]Discord[/url] or follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/happybroccgames]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/happybroccoligames/]Instagram [/url]and [url=https://tiktok.com/@happybroccoligames]TikTok[/url] for fresh updates and news in the upcoming months! 

Don't forget to get your copy and leave a review if you haven't done so yet!
Reviews realy help us a lot! <3
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1158220/Kraken_Academy/

[url=https://discord.com/invite/6364PA6Jkv][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36022497/db0963438c92916db0946e4bf422239bbbbd74c7.gif[/img][/url]

notes.title: KA Update Patch v1.0.12
notes.content:
v1.0.12 changelog:

- updated and improved sections of the Chinese localization.
- updated HUD to be ~20% larger
- added gamepad rumble support (only tested for xbox gamepads)
- sprinting and navigating menus only on triggers w/ gamepads.

- auto save can now happen after freeing a spirit.
- auto save now occurs every 3 mins, down from 5 mins.

- Janitor grumpiness reduced. Will now accept the torch on Tuesday evening before 7pm
- dying while defeating the final boss counts as a victory.
- fixed soft-lock during final boss fight if you didn't accept Vilen's help.
- fixed soft-lock issue when entering a new area.
- time will no longer move forward when entering the Drama Club (prevents corrupting of auto save file).

- pine trees in sports club updated.
- removed scanlines from security footage in art exhibition centre.
- water is slower at the water park.
- fixed animations if you failed band QTE at the party.
- fixed issue with character names when switching between Russian and other languages.

Thanks for playing!

- fixed an issue with character portraits not resetting in final sequence.

- boss's office lighting will not get darker after flashback.
- Dimitri's minigame combo resets when replaying.

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: KA Update Patch v1.0.7
notes.content:
v1.0.7 changelog

- Mr. Whistler is a lot less curious about Red Paint.
- can no longer interact with cauldron after chanting.
- fixed kraken-net translation in Kostadin's bio in Russian.
- fixed some UI not updating after changing key bindings.
- can complete Ana's quest at night.
- can re-complete Wendy challenge to gain Statue Receipt (requires time rewind to fix).
- trial portraits will now show - more drama!
- fixed issue with Kostadin wanting to start the trial too soon in a new time-loop.
- Time HUD will be a lot less shy after going to the costume party. 
- Player painting will not change color in art exhibition.

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: The Academy Newsletter: March Edition
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36022497/538fbdf6e1db95a0d81b12c307be12af3cbe3d03.png[/img]

Hello and welcome to the March edition of the Academy Newsletter! This is what we’ve been working on this month!

[u]Development[/u]
Annika has been writing the dates! This means you will be able to take Broccoli Girl to the newly opened water park, go with Simona to the movies and take Vladimir out to a market fair. 
(This is how Broccoli Girl looks like in a swimsuit :D)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36022497/6833f5818438a7378dd6d6bbb8cd0c06a7f76084.png[/img]
We also finished writing the side quests and we really love how they’ve come together, can’t wait to show them to the world!!
There will be an unusual family reunion, an uprising of the machines and you’ll have to help write a love letter, just to name a few.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36022497/e9d055e1363fd2c8b08ba035008543330f7efab5.png[/img]

Joni has implemented the final scenes of the game, including the final boss battles and has been pottering about the Drama club, fixing up things here and there.
Sneak peek of the Drama Club area:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36022497/2bde4db7077a5be44cb4100dc83066d9b8093564.png[/img]


[u]Character Intros[/u]

This month we’ve introduced Ana and the Player’s Mom!

Ana is a clumsy art student who makes sculptures. She loves her grandma very much and writes her letters every week. She’s voiced by [url=https://twitter.com/LizzieRFreeman]Lizzie Freeman[/url]! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36022497/db9d4836cf800fc9eac9840e9aecb07f8ed30627.png[/img]

The player’s mom is a single mother. Although she does her best, you can tell that your sister is the favourite child. She takes care of your belongings while you're away in boarding school, which results in her selling half of your N69 games and comics. Voiced by [url=https://twitter.com/nolaklop]Nola Klop[/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36022497/57fcfbe8f818a0075ef7ddc6a583fb7cbde6f0ea.png[/img]

[u]Merch[/u]

After being stuck in customs for over 3 weeks, the Broccoli Girl pins have finally arrived!!! There will be a chance to win one closer to release, join our [url=http://bit.ly/3c0xBX5]Discord [/url] if you want to know more :D

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36022497/1edb6489e1071124922959110ed0195496e87ff1.jpg[/img]


We started sending merch to all collaborators in the game: voice over actors, artists, etc. Our printer stopped working so we had to label every envelope by hand D: was a lot of fun though!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36022497/9b1030ac053cdc3c2bd1695851ba601d505b9b68.jpg[/img]


[u]Casting call[/u]

We just announced our latest casting call!!
This time our open roles range from lovely grandma to vampire drama teacher :D

You can [url=https://www.castingcall.club/projects/last-casting-call-for-kraken-academy-2f-2m]apply here[/url] until the 7th of April. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36022497/b58bd2eb140cece88a0b57e0bcdf9842e63bf5ca.png[/img]

[u]Events[/u]

We’re part of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/iwocon2021]IWOCon[/url] which is now live until the 2nd of April, and it’s been so much fun so far!!

Oh and we were also nominated for the [url=http://valenciaindiesummit.com/awards.html]Valencia Indie Awards[/url] :)

So much going on at the moment!! Follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/happybroccgames]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/happybroccoligames/]Instagram[/url] and [url=http://bit.ly/3c0xBX5]Discord [/url] for the latest news! :D

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36022497/db0963438c92916db0946e4bf422239bbbbd74c7.gif[/img]
